mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FO_COM_CODE ( COM_TYPE, INFO_TYPE, SHRN_ISCD, STND_ISCD, KOR_NAME, ATM_CLS_CODE, ACPR, MMSC_CLS_CODE, PROD_NO, PROD_NAME ) VALUES ( #{comType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{infoType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{shrnIscd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stndIscd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{korName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{atmClsCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{acpr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{mmscClsCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prodNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prodName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

MERGE INTO FO_COM_CODE t USING DUAL ON (t.COM_TYPE = #{comType} AND t.INFO_TYPE = #{infoType} AND t.STND_ISCD = #{stndIscd}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.SHRN_ISCD = #{shrnIscd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.KOR_NAME = #{korName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.ATM_CLS_CODE = #{atmClsCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.ACPR = #{acpr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.MMSC_CLS_CODE = #{mmscClsCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.PROD_NO = #{prodNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.PROD_NAME = #{prodName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( COM_TYPE, INFO_TYPE, SHRN_ISCD, STND_ISCD, KOR_NAME, ATM_CLS_CODE, ACPR, MMSC_CLS_CODE, PROD_NO, PROD_NAME ) VALUES ( #{comType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{infoType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{shrnIscd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stndIscd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{korName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{atmClsCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{acpr, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{mmscClsCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prodNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prodName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
